data.source: METR time horizons (Time Horizon 1.1 current; 1.0 legacy), as published in Epoch AI's benchmark data (monthly Wayback captures = point-in-time vintages)

limitations: Measures software-task completion under METR's benchmark conditions, not general intelligence or capability in every domain.
Few real point-in-time vintages: most backtest origins are reconstructed, so scores are approximate.
Only evaluated models are seen: labs and models METR has not measured are missing (selection bias).
Horizons above 16 hours are near the top of METR's task suite: their CIs are wide and they are left out of trend fits.
The v1.0 to v1.1 bridge rests on a handful of models measured under both suites.
Ranges are 80% predictive intervals from simulated trajectories; their calibration is only as good as the backtest coverage shown.
